nom: CHANEL HYDRA BEAUTY MICRO SÉRUM Rebalancing Replenishing Hydration

avis.titre: Kind to my dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive, dry, acne-prone skin. I develop cystic acne along jawline. Espwcially during thewinter, I tend to have dry patches around my eyebrows and my nose. Ive been applying this serum twice daily on most days along with Chanel No 1 cream (not the rich one, the regular one). I havent had any issues with dryness this winter, as opposed to last winter when i only used chanel no 1 cream. This was the missing step for me. It absorbs quickly, though if you plan to wear with makeup, i would only do 1 pump to avoid slippage (i do 1 pump in the morning before makeup routine, 2 at night especially if applying retinol/retinoid product). I've bought my second bottle, but my first one (1.0 oz) still has 1/4 left and ive had it for 6+ months.

**purchased with my own money** This is a great serum for hydrating the skin. It layers well with other serums & moisturizers, and also under makeup. I knocked one star off for cost, but it's Chanel, it's going to be pricey. I will continue to purchase and use this serum as it works well with my dry skin.
They gave me sample and I fell in love with it. It's a great serum to wake up your face in the morning. Blends very well with your makeup I wish if it wish if it was more affordable.
